subsection.name: Writing the view
subsection.p: The view interacts directly with the user. In Scope, all views can be bound to a model and issue controls. Depending on the environment, the actual implementation of a view can change a lot.

subsection.name: View responsabilities
subsection.p:
The view is responsible for:
presenting the information stored in the bound model to the user.
allowing the user to interact with this information, and to change the data in the model.
transforming the user actions into Controls to be interpreted by the Controller.

subsection.name: Binding a view to a model
The different types of views implemented in Scope
subsection.p:
Scope provides the following support for the different types of views:
View type Main view class to use
Swing org.scopemvc.view.swing.SPanel
Servlet org.scopemvc.view.servlet.Page
JSP org.scopemvc.view.servlet.jsp.JSPPage
XML+XSLT org.scopemvc.view.servlet.xml.XSLPPage
